subject: Implement cost accountant (Logfire reader / per-call accumulator)
description:
Build `capo/budget/accountant.py` — reads Logfire's per-run cost (or a custom per-call accumulator when Logfire is unavailable) and persists daily totals to `daily_costs(date, model, user_id, usd_total)`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `Accountant.record(model, usd, user_id)` updates `daily_costs` for `(today_local_date, model, user_id)`.
- [ ] Daily totals are read efficiently for cap-check hot path.
- [ ] Logfire is the canonical source; per-call accumulator is the fallback when Logfire is unreachable.
- [ ] Per-delegation cost is logged on the `delegations.cost_usd` row but does NOT count against Capo's daily total in V1 (per §5.9 acceptance).
- [ ] Nightly reconciliation step emits a `capo.budget.reconcile` Logfire span with `accumulator_usd`, `logfire_usd`, `drift_usd`.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Resets at local midnight (per §5.9): timezone is local to the Mac mini.
- [ ] Logfire unavailable mid-day: switch to accumulator; reconcile when Logfire returns.

_Performance:_
- [ ] Cap-check read path < 5ms (hot path called before every `agent.run` and `delegate_*`).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: record + read flow
• Unit: midnight reset
• Integration: reconciliation span emitted with all three values

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.9, 6.4, 6.5, 9.5
